facts.raw_span: a 2-year history of hip pain following low-impact falls
stress fractures of the left rib, left sacrum, and left femoral neck
elevated alkaline phosphatase level of 220 U/L
phosphorus level of 2.1 mg/dL
25-OH vitamin D 14.8 ng/mL
FGF23 1241 RU/mL
Z-scores of −2.5 in the lumbar spine and −1.9 in the femoral neck
a slow gait with a limp and lumbar tenderness
alkaline phosphatase 204 U/L
phosphorus 1.6 mg/dL
a 9×8-mm intracortical lesion in the anterolateral right fibular head

concepts.why: The patient's history of hip pain, stress fractures, and elevated FGF23 levels are consistent with X-linked hypophosphatemia.
The patient's low phosphorus levels, elevated alkaline phosphatase, and bone pain are consistent with hypophosphatemic rickets.
The patient's elevated alkaline phosphatase, low 25-OH vitamin D, and bone pain are consistent with osteomalacia.
The patient's history of stress fractures, elevated alkaline phosphatase, and intracortical lesion are consistent with fibrous dysplasia.
The patient's low phosphorus levels, elevated alkaline phosphatase, and bone pain are consistent with rickets.
The patient's history of hip pain, stress fractures, and elevated FGF23 levels are consistent with hypophosphatasia.
The patient's low 25-OH vitamin D levels and bone pain are consistent with vitamin D deficiency.
The patient's low bone density and history of stress fractures are consistent with osteopenia.
